notes.Luka Doncic: Austin Reaves (left heel bruise) and Walker Kessler (right lower-leg soreness) are both out tonight, so even more of the Lakers' offense runs through him. With Reaves out Sunday he played 36 minutes and scored 43, and Charlotte is without Dennis Schroder and Kon Knueppel.
notes.Victor Wembanyama: Detroit is without its starting center, Jalen Duren (right hamstring strain), plus Duncan Robinson, Taurean Prince and Ronald Holland II, with Isaiah Joe doubtful. He played 35 minutes Sunday, and De'Aaron Fox, who missed that game, is not on San Antonio's injury report tonight.
notes.Cade Cunningham: Detroit is down to a thin rotation: Jalen Duren, Duncan Robinson, Taurean Prince and Ronald Holland II are out and Isaiah Joe is doubtful, so the offense leans on him and Daniss Jenkins. He played 36 minutes Saturday; the one risk is San Antonio being an 8.5-point favorite.
notes.Karl-Anthony Towns: He played 43 minutes in Sunday's overtime win in Toronto, scoring 15 of his 28 in the fourth quarter, and this is a rematch in Toronto two nights later. New York has nobody on tonight's injury report, and Toronto has been starting the smaller Collin Murray-Boyles at center over Jakob Poeltl.
notes.Deni Avdija: Ja Morant (hamstring, out until at least Thanksgiving) and Shaedon Sharpe are still out, so Portland's offense runs through his drives; 22 of Portland's first 41 points Monday came in the paint. He played only 30 minutes because Portland emptied its bench down 19 late, and Portland had not posted its injury report Tuesday morning for this back-to-back rematch.
notes.Damian Lillard: Portland emptied its bench with 7:28 left Monday, so he played only 24 minutes, and tonight is the second night of a back-to-back in Minnesota. Portland had not posted its injury report Tuesday morning, so a rest night or lighter minutes is possible.
notes.Donovan Clingan: His size gave Minnesota trouble early Monday, especially in the paint, and he blocked five shots in 22 minutes. It is the same matchup in Minneapolis tonight, but Portland had not posted its injury report Tuesday morning.
notes.Robert Williams: He backs up Donovan Clingan at center and played 15 minutes Monday. Portland had not posted its injury report Tuesday morning for this second night of a back-to-back, and any rest for Clingan would open more minutes for him.
With Anthony Edwards (knee surgery) and Jaylen Clark (hamstring strain) out, he played 35 minutes off the bench Monday, up from 21 and 22 his two games before, and took over in the second and fourth quarters. Jonathan Kuminga also left Monday with a right shoulder injury, and Minnesota had not posted its injury report Tuesday morning.
notes.Jonathan Kuminga: He left Monday's win with 6:35 left in the fourth quarter with a right shoulder injury, and no diagnosis had been announced Tuesday morning. Minnesota had not posted its injury report yet; if he sits, Terrence Shannon Jr. is the first in line for more minutes.
notes.LaMelo Ball: He is in a two-game shooting slump (2 of 13 Monday after 7 of 25 Saturday), and he played only 24 minutes Monday as Minnesota pulled away. With Anthony Edwards out, he still runs the offense, and Minnesota had not posted its injury report Tuesday morning.
notes.Rudy Gobert: He played 32 minutes Monday, up from 23 and 27 his two games before, and had 15 rebounds against Donovan Clingan's size. It is the same matchup tonight.
notes.Brice Sensabaugh: With Lauri Markkanen (hand fracture) and Jaren Jackson Jr. (MCL tear) out, his minutes off the bench have climbed from 23 to 27 to 30 over his last three games. Both are out again tonight.
notes.Mo Bamba: With Jusuf Nurkic and Jaxson Hayes out, he started Sunday and played 36 minutes after 15 to 20 off the bench before. Both are out again tonight, so he should keep the starting center job.
notes.Keyonte George: He sprained his right ankle Sunday and missed the fourth quarter, but he is not on Utah's injury report tonight. With Lauri Markkanen and Jaren Jackson Jr. out, he and Darryn Peterson carry most of the offense.
notes.Javonte Green: Detroit is very short on wings: Duncan Robinson (quadriceps), Taurean Prince and Ronald Holland II are out and Isaiah Joe is doubtful. He played only 11 to 15 minutes in his last three games, so the bigger role tonight comes from the absences, not from a trend.
notes.Kevin Huerter: Duncan Robinson left Saturday's game after 17 minutes with a left quadriceps strain, and Huerter played 38 minutes off the bench. Robinson is out tonight, so Huerter could move into the starting lineup.
notes.Daniss Jenkins: He has started Detroit's last three games and played 35 to 42 minutes in them. With Robinson, Prince and Holland out and Isaiah Joe doubtful, Detroit has few other ball handlers behind him and Cade Cunningham.
notes.Jarred Vanderbilt: Walker Kessler is out tonight (right lower-leg soreness), his first absence of the season, and Vanderbilt, Sandro Mamukelashvili and Kevon Looney are in line to split the frontcourt minutes. He played 12 minutes Sunday, so the bump depends on how the Lakers split center time.
notes.Sandro Mamukelashvili: Walker Kessler is out tonight, his first absence of the season, so he is the most likely Laker to take the center minutes. He played 32 and 26 minutes off the bench in the two games before Sunday's 21.
notes.Quentin Grimes: Austin Reaves is out again with a left heel bruise, and Grimes started in his place Sunday and played 37 minutes. He is listed as available tonight while wearing a right finger splint.
notes.Gradey Dick: Bradley Beal and Brandon Ingram (recovering from heel surgery) are out again, and Dick has played exactly 19 minutes off the bench in each of his last three games. The minutes are steady, but he has not moved into the starting lineup.
notes.Darius Garland: With Bradley Beal and Brandon Ingram out, he has played 37 and 35 minutes in his last two games and runs the Clippers' offense. Utah is without Lauri Markkanen and Jaren Jackson Jr.
notes.Ryan Kalkbrenner: He started on 11/09 and played 35 minutes, but he has come off the bench for 16 and 18 minutes in the two games since, with Moussa Diabate starting. The Lakers are without Walker Kessler, which thins out the bigs he faces tonight.
notes.Sion James: Kon Knueppel and Dennis Schroder are both out with left hamstring strains, and James has started and played 32 to 35 minutes in each of Charlotte's last three games. His minutes are steady even though his scoring has been light.
notes.Coby White: He is on a minutes limit after a calf strain and has played exactly 20 minutes as a starter in each of his last three games. Dennis Schroder's absence keeps him in the starting lineup, but the limit caps his ceiling.
notes.Scottie Barnes: He returned Sunday from a four-game absence with a left groin strain, played 36 minutes and hit the 27-foot three that forced overtime against New York. Kawhi Leonard is out again tonight (left knee injury management).
notes.Collin Murray-Boyles: He has kept the starting center job over Jakob Poeltl and played 40 minutes Sunday, including all of overtime, even with Scottie Barnes back. This is a rematch with the same Knicks two nights later.
notes.Jalen Brunson: He played 41 minutes in Sunday's overtime win in Toronto and hit the go-ahead three with 33.4 seconds left in overtime. New York has nobody on tonight's injury report for the rematch.
notes.De'Aaron Fox: He missed Sunday's game, but he is not on San Antonio's injury report tonight. His return would take some ball-handling from Stephon Castle and Dylan Harper, who played 35 and 34 minutes Sunday.
